actions.chat_completion.description: Get a chat completion using a Parallel processor. OpenAI-compatible interface; processor names like 'speed', 'base', 'core', 'pro', 'ultra' map to Parallel tiers.
actions.chat_completion.props.json_schem: Used when Response Format is "JSON Schema". Provide a JSON Schema object.
Name for the JSON schema (required when Response Format is JSON Schema).
actions.chat_completion.props.response_f: Whether the model should return free text or a JSON object.
actions.chat_completion.props.system.des: Optional system message to set the assistant behaviour.
actions.create_findall_run.description: Discover and verify entities matching plain-language criteria. Match conditions can be supplied directly or auto-generated from the objective.
actions.create_findall_run.props.generat: Generator tier — higher tiers use deeper search at higher cost.
actions.create_findall_run.props.match_c: Array of `{ "name": "...", "description": "..." }` objects describing the criteria each match must satisfy. Leave empty to auto-generate from the objective.
actions.create_findall_run.props.match_l: Maximum number of matches to find (5–1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.create_findall_run.props.metadat: Optional key/value metadata stored with the run.
actions.create_findall_run.props.objecti: Natural-language description of the target entities. e.g. "AI companies that raised Series A funding in 2024".
actions.create_task_run.description: Initiate a Parallel research task. Returns immediately with a queued run; use Get Task Run Result to wait for completion.
actions.create_task_run.props.exclude_do: Optional source policy: exclude results from these domains.
actions.create_task_run.props.include_do: Optional source policy: only return results from these domains.
actions.create_task_run.props.input.desc: Input to the task (free text or a JSON string). Example: "What was the GDP of France in 2023?"
actions.create_task_run.props.metadata.d: Optional key/value metadata stored with the run (keys ≤16 chars, values ≤512 chars).
actions.create_task_run.props.output_jso: Used when Output Schema Type is "JSON Schema". A JSON Schema object describing the desired structured output.
actions.create_task_run.props.output_sch: How the task should structure its output.
actions.create_task_run.props.output_tex: Used when Output Schema Type is "Text". Plain-language description of the desired output.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.extract.description: Extract clean, citation-aware content from specific web URLs. Up to 20 URLs per request.
actions.extract.props.full_content.descr: When enabled, requests full markdown of each page in addition to excerpts. May increase latency.
actions.extract.props.max_chars_total.de: Upper bound on total characters across excerpts from all results.
actions.extract.props.objective.descript: Natural-language description of the goal driving the extraction. Used to focus excerpts on the most relevant content.
actions.extract.props.search_queries.des: Optional keyword search queries used together with the objective to focus excerpts.
actions.extract.props.session_id.descrip: Optional session identifier to share context across search/extract calls.
actions.extract.props.urls.description: List of URLs to extract content from (max 20).
actions.get_findall_result.description: Return the current snapshot of matched candidates for a FindAll run, including any enrichment fields.
actions.get_findall_result.props.findall: The FindAll run ID returned from Create FindAll Run.
actions.get_task_run.description: Retrieve the current status of a task run by its ID.
actions.get_task_run_result.description: Retrieve a task run result by run ID. Blocks until the run completes (or until the timeout is reached).
actions.get_task_run_result.props.run_id: The task run ID returned from Create Task Run.
actions.get_task_run_result.props.timeou: How long to wait for the run to complete. Defaults to 600 seconds.
actions.search.description: Search the web with natural-language objectives. Returns LLM-optimized excerpts with citations.
actions.search.props.exclude_domains.des: Optional list of domains to exclude from results.
actions.search.props.include_domains.des: Optional list of domains to restrict results to (e.g. wikipedia.org, .gov).
actions.search.props.max_chars_total.des: Upper bound on total characters across excerpts from all results.
actions.search.props.mode.description: Basic: low latency with 2-3 high-quality queries. Advanced: higher quality with deeper retrieval.
actions.search.props.objective.descripti: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent.
actions.search.props.search_queries.desc: Concise keyword search queries (3-6 words each). At least one query is required; 2-3 is best.
actions.search.props.session_id.descript: Optional session identifier to share context across search/extract calls.
auth.description:
**Get your Parallel API key:**

1. Sign in at https://platform.parallel.ai
2. Navigate to **API Keys**
3. Create a new key and paste it here.
description: Web research APIs for AI: search, extract, multi-hop research tasks, entity discovery (FindAll), and web monitoring.
